4.9 stars. 212 reviews. A café inside Sunset Town that almost nobody talks about.

Cafe Juliet & Pastries sits inside Venice 07 of Sunset Town, Phú Quốc, and the numbers don't lie. Budget $15-30 per person and you're getting serious coffee and pastries in one of the most photogenic spots on the island.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
